name: real-favourite-origins-get-their-icons
description:
Thirteen favourites on real origins from a user's BPX and Eventim spaces, in a profile whose favicon database is empty, so every tile depends on the site fetch. Eleven origins answer /favicon.ico with an image, some through a redirect. app.clockify.me answers 404 there and names its icon in a link tag instead, which the page-fetch tier reads. git.eventim.net does not resolve outside its VPN, so that one is expected to stay blank and is excluded from the gate.

The missing-tiles eval names which favourites had no loaded icon at the deadline, which is the evidence a report of 'a lot of favicons are missing' needs.

actions.expression: (() => { const skip = ['git.eventim.net']; const ids = new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].map(f => f.dataset.favId || '').filter(id => id && !skip.some(s => id.includes(s)))); const ok = new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter(f => f.querySelector('.fvimg.ok')).map(f => f.dataset.favId)); return String(ids.size > 0 && [...ids].every(id => ok.has(id))); })()
actions.note: every favourite whose origin serves an icon over the network has one on screen

actions.expression: (() => { const ok = new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter(f => f.querySelector('.fvimg.ok')).map(f => f.dataset.favId)); return [...new Set([...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].map(f => f.dataset.favId || ''))].filter(id => id && !ok.has(id)).join(' ') || 'none'; })()
actions.note: recorded, not asserted: which favourites have no loaded icon

actions.expression: (() => { const seen = new Set(); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.fav')].filter(f => { const id = f.dataset.favId; if (seen.has(id)) return false; seen.add(id); return true; }).map(f => { const i = f.querySelector('.fvimg'); return (f.dataset.favId || '?').replace(/^https:\/\//, '').slice(0, 28) + '=' + (i ? (i.classList.contains('ok') ? 'ok' : 'img') : 'none'); }).join(' '); })()
actions.note: recorded: per tile, whether an img exists and whether it loaded

assertions.desc: the backfill asked for the cold tiles
every favourite on an origin that serves an icon shows it
